hook: Outside testers say Anthropic's AI improves twice as fast

beats.say: Outside testers say Anthropic's AI improves twice as fast.
Here's what's new. Days ago, Anthropic itself said self-building AI may be close. Now METR, an independent nonprofit, has checked from the inside: eleven weeks, with rare access to internal data.
Their finding: since October twenty twenty-five, Anthropic's AI test scores have climbed about one point nine times faster. That's roughly two years of progress | in one.
So what's driving it? METR's best guess: AI itself. Anthropic uses AI heavily for research, and METR puts maybe eighty percent of the speed-up on that.
Why care? If AI speeds up building AI, new models could arrive faster than the rules for them. For now, METR says AI mostly assists. It's not running the research alone.
The catch? METR says it *isn't* confident. Anthropic's staff didn't all agree, and METR may be overestimating. Plus, Anthropic blacked out most of the key evidence, saying it's confidential.
